title: Total Small Business Set Aside for Library Archive Digitization Services and 4 Option Years - CMMC Level 2 Self Assessment Required.
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NAVAL SURFACE WARFARE CENTER
description_text:
This is a Request for Quote (RFQ) as a Total Small Business Set-Aside for Library Archive Digitization Services and 4 Option Years .

Please submit your quote to terra.s.roberts.civ@us.navy.mil on or before the closing date and time stated above. Late quotes will not be considered.

Your quote should include the following information:

Unit Price: For the specified Library Archive Digitization Services 

Shipping Cost: If shipping is not included in the unit price, please provide a separate line item for shipping costs.

CAGE Code: Your company's Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) code.

Lead Time: Estimated delivery timeframe after receipt of order.

Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) required is Level 2 Self Assessment –this must be completed prior to Award.

WAWF Capability: Confirmation of your ability to invoice through Wide Area Workflow (WAWF).

All invoices are NET30 and submitted through WAWF.

Please refer to the attached document for the product description, quantity, and other pertinent details.

The Government will award this procurement based on the best value, considering price, delivery, quality, and past performance. Please carefully review all attachments.
